# Hardik Yadav - Full-Stack Developer & AI Builder

Hardik Yadav is a Full-Stack Developer, Software Engineer, UI/UX Designer, and AI Builder based in Saharanpur, Uttar Pradesh, India. He specializes in creating scalable web architectures, intelligent AI systems, and modern digital experiences.

## Technical Expertise
- Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- Backend: Node.js, Express, Python
- Database: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQL, NoSQL
- AI & ML: Machine Learning, LLM Integration, Data Engineering
- Cloud: Google Cloud, Firebase, Vercel

## Business Entities
Hardik Yadav is the founder of HRDK Developers (also known as HRDK), a software company that provides web development, graphic designing, SEO, digital marketing, system architecture, and technical consulting services.
